name: qwen3.8-flash-next-nvfp4-tp2
description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 (125B/~6B active hybrid MoE), TP2 + expert parallel, MTP3, FULL_DECODE_ONLY CUDA graphs, 262K context.

source.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 — TP2+EP, MTP3
source.author: getrefined (vLLM lane), MiaAI-Lab (SGLang lane)
requirements: An image with Qwen3.8-Flash-Next support for sm_121 — pin the one from the recipe repo (Pin → image).
The 47.7 GiB n-gram (PLE) table stays resident at TP2 unless the image carries the disk-backed patch; keep torch.compile off when it is resident (a second table copy can reboot the Sparks).
notes: Native context 262K (YaRN to ~1M). Artificial Analysis rates it very verbose.
Experimental: flags follow the published recipe; verify with `tsm plan` against the pinned image.
